verdict_reason: The decoder is correct, scoped to MdmClient only and tested end to end, but its 502/503/504 rule is duplicated in MdmClientInterceptor.

todos.issue: The rule for which upstream statuses mean 'unavailable' has two homes, both added by this PR: 'case 502, 503, 504 ->' at MdmErrorDecoder.java:15 and 'ex.status() == 502 || ex.status() == 503 || ex.status() == 504' at MdmClientInterceptor.java:64. Both decide the same outcome (a 503 answer rather than a 500), so adding a status to one leaves MDM and the token endpoint answering differently.
todos.fix: Must: one named owner holds the set of statuses that mean an upstream is unavailable, and both the MDM decoder and the token call use it. One way: a static predicate such as isUnavailableStatus(int) that MdmErrorDecoder and MdmClientInterceptor.getToken both call.
